stock.description: Ying Hai Group Holdings, an investment holding company, operates as a licensed wholesale travel provider, specializing in delivering business-to-business (B2B) domestic travel solutions to other agencies. Its comprehensive range of services includes the sale and distribution of airline tickets and hotel accommodations, along with the provision of vehicle leasing and chauffeur services. Additionally, the company supplies various supplementary travel-related products, such as passes for entertainment and dining buffets, transportation tickets, travel insurance, and assistance with visa applications. The firm was established in 2014 and is headquartered in Macau.
